statements.status_notes: libopenexr is pulled in via gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad, part of the WebKit media dependency set that upstream Playwright's install-deps mandates for Debian 13. No fixed version is available in Debian trixie. Whether Playwright-driven WebKit sessions can reach the EXR decode paths with untrusted input is under investigation.
